protocol.name: direct_baselines_trial_v1
protocol.proposed_policy: local-first; preliminary filtering and revalidation; size-dependent DGWO selection
protocol.baseline_policy: all network-wide edge peers; no preliminary filtering or preselection revalidation
protocol.fitness_policy: Greedy/PSO/GWO penalize infeasible candidates during evaluation without removing them
protocol.random_policy: seeded random permutation; final verification without repeated devices
protocol.final_verification: same verify_candidate_for_execution and offload_task safeguards for all Edge policies
protocol.source_policy: same modeled source feasibility, scheduling, rejection and release
protocol.timing_scope: preselection + selection + final Edge verification; excludes resource commit, execution and source-only fallback scheduling
protocol.comparison_scope: complete policies; not an isolated optimizer comparison
